$schema: Personal date-based reminders for morning briefing surfacing. Checked daily; items within 7 days surface as amber, within 1 day as red.

items.title: Scaleway Startup Program decision due — PIVOT DECISION POINT
items.detail: 21 business days from 2026-04-05 submission. Expected decision by ~2026-05-06 (adjusted for French Labour Day 2026-05-01). If ACCEPTED: deploy Climate Assistant on Scaleway Gen APIs with credits. If REJECTED: execute DGX Spark pivot plan (order hardware D+1, migrate D+14-28, keep Scaleway Object Storage WORM at €2-5/mo, re-apply 2026-07-05). If SILENCE: ping startup-program@scaleway.com. Application #2 of 3 allowed. Full plan in field note.
items.actionOnDueDate: 1) Check inbox. 2) If accepted → deploy on Scaleway. 3) If rejected → order DGX Spark, start migration. 4) If silence → email Scaleway.

items.title: DO NOT reduce Scaleway spend during 21-day review window
items.detail: Visible €18/mo → €0/mo drop during Scaleway's 21-day review maps to rejection ground #1 (credit-shopping). Keep existing assistant container running as-is until decision on 2026-05-06. ~€13 pro-rated is trust-preserving spend. Reminder auto-clears on decision date.
